title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1969-06-05

ai_review.summary: A wildly cryptic, high‑energy show that ranks among the Dead's best, but captured on a patchy recording.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the performance’s mystical vibe, calling it possibly the second or third best ever, while noting the audio is uneven and “very patchy.” The recording’s technical flaws don’t completely mask the concert’s brilliance, resulting in a mixed yet overall positive impression.

ai_rating.rationale: One reviewer gives a strong 4‑star endorsement of the show, while another rates it 3 stars and points out patchy audio. The combined weighting yields an overall rating in the mid‑range.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as “very patchy,” suggesting inconsistent sound quality, possible dropouts or uneven mixing.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The concert is praised for being ‘wicked cryptical’ and possibly one of the top shows, though reviewers give no specific song details.
